bullets.text: In Mangadu, a youth undergoing treatment at a de-addiction centre was allegedly killed by the staff, prompting the office to monitor the police investigation.
A security guard named Kannaiyan died after a high-voltage power cable snapped near Avadi, and the office should track compensation and safety measures.
Heavy rains and waterlogging have been reported across Chennai and Avadi, and the office must coordinate with civic bodies on relief efforts.
Minister R. Kumar inspected ongoing northeast monsoon precautionary works in the Adyar zone, and the office should follow up on the directives issued.
The Okkiyam Maduvu project is set to be a major gamechanger for south Chennai drainage, and the office should review its implementation progress.
Work on the GCC food court in Adyar has only reached 40 percent completion and is delayed to 2027, requiring local project tracking.
Residents in Adyar are driving a Joy of Giving collection campaign at LB Road, which the office can acknowledge and support.

The INS Samarthak warship built in Kattupalli, Thiruvallur district, was inducted into the Indian Navy in the presence of dignitaries.
Avadi cybercrime police arrested a Delhi man for swindling 1.90 crores from an Ambattur firm, and the office should note the cyber cell's action.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Singapore Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong unveiled CapitaLand's new Rs 1,940 crore data centre in Ambattur.
Infosys plans to hire 20,000 freshers amid AI transformations in the IT sector, which is a positive development for youth employment.
IndiaAI Fellowship 2026-27 applications are open offering students up to Rs 2 lakh, and the portfolio team should publicize student outreach.
The DMK has demanded the CEC's removal over the SIR row and criticized political opponents, which the office should monitor politically.
The current government has cancelled tenders for roadside amenity centres initiated during the previous administration, requiring administrative tracking.
